usedFor: Google Meet holds meetings, and Sangam CRM records each “New Meeting” as a lead through “Create a new Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Create a new Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A created meeting becomes a lead with an optional next follow-up date, so no call goes unlogged.

watchOut: “New Meeting” is polling, so “Create a new Lead” runs after a scheduled check, not when the meeting is made.
